title: BL∞ Hypothesis Branch / Nhánh Giả thuyết
truth_authority: Reality Veto where empirical actuality is at stake
purpose: Collect supportive speculative research objects without silently upgrading them into established BL theory or narrative canon.

objects.title: Compressed Superentity / Information-Carrier Hypothesis
objects.role: Tests whether very large historical experience could be preserved as a compressed generative seed rather than literal full-memory transfer.
objects.nonclaim: Does not establish that such a carrier exists in physical reality.

objects.title: Million Regression Hypothesis
objects.role: Explores repeated trajectories and what structures might survive extreme iterative history compression and reconstruction.
objects.nonclaim: The number one million is not presented as an experimentally verified physical history.

objects.title: Physical Future-to-Past Information Hypothesis
objects.role: Keeps open, but strictly separates, the strongest physical possibility of controllable future-to-past information from ordinary future-boundary backcasting.
objects.nonclaim: Current physics does not establish controllable backward-in-time information transfer; BackwardInference is not BackwardSignal.

objects.title: Terminal Low-Generativity / Cosmic Optionality Hypothesis
objects.role: Explores terminal regimes in which usable optionality and generative reachability collapse even when existence has not literally vanished.
objects.nonclaim: Does not claim that a specific BL Grand Ending is established by contemporary cosmology.
